title: Transcript
description: Daybreak's transcript.json: the two tracks merged into one conversation in time order (Transcript, TranscriptSegment). Field names are Daybreak's; id and basis are kit additions and optional here.

id.description: Stable within one transcript revision; never reused for changed text or times.

basis.description: How the speaker was attributed. track: from which audio track it came (Daybreak's two-track capture). diarization: a model guessed it. platform: the meeting platform said who was speaking (a meeting bot). manual: a person set it.

speakerName.description: The display name the meeting platform showed for whoever spoke, when a bot captured it. speaker still says only you or them; a name never goes there.
